tagline: Find your dream career
description: Established in 2005, Careers24 is South Africa's leading career portal.   We provide companies and recruiters with the platform to post job ads and give job seekers the opportunity to apply to 1000s of vacancies.  As a proud member of Naspers, Africa's largest media company, all jobs posted on Careers24 receive vast exposure, as the listings are seen across a network of leading sites such as News24.com, OLX.co.za and beyond.   Recruiters are also given the opportunity to search our broad database of quality candidate CVs in over 40 various sectors - ranging through Marketing, Tech, Engineering, Finance and more.  The Careers24 free job search app and mobi site allows job seekers to search and apply for vacancies 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, providing recruiters with a consistent supply of motivated job seekers. Career advice and Job Alerts are additional benefits that assist job seekers to improve their hire-ability and successfully build their careers.  More than just a job listings site, Careers24 uses innovative tools and easy-to-use functionality to help both recruiters and candidates find the best match.   We're based in Johannesburg and Cape Town, but have expanded to various regions in Africa, including Nigeria. For more information, or to advertise a vacancy on Careers24, please email our sales office on sales@careers24.com or call +27(0)11 713 9000.

name: Recruitment Matters Africa (Pvt) Ltd
tagline: Pan African Recruitment Specialists - Zimbabwe, Zambia, South Africa, Namibia, Mauritius and across Africa
description: Recruitment Matters is a pan-African recruitment agency focused on connecting businesses with high-impact talent across the continent.  Founded in 2010, the business has built a strong reputation for delivering recruitment solutions in complex and diverse markets, with a particular strength in logistics, supply chain, agribusiness, manufacturing, FMCG and finance  With offices in Zambia, Zimbabwe, South Africa, Namibia, and Mauritius Recruitment Matters supports clients across Africa, working closely with both regional businesses and global organisations operating in-country.  What sets the firm apart is a practical, on-the-ground approach. Rather than working at arm’s length, the team focuses on understanding the realities within each market from infrastructure and operational challenges to cultural dynamics — ensuring candidates are not just technically capable, but the right fit for the environment.  The business operates across both contingency and executive retained search mandates, often supporting clients on senior and hard-to-fill roles, where a deeper, more consultative approach is required.  At its core, Recruitment Matters is about building long-term partnerships helping businesses grow by placing the right people in the right roles across Africa.

name: IxDF - The Interaction Design Foundation
description: On a mission to help people who feel stuck in their careers make a fast and fulfilling transition into design and tech. We’re here to help you build skills that improve lives, create products and services people love, and lead to salaries that reflect real value.   Design isn’t just for designers. It’s for anyone, in any job or industry, because it’s rooted in something timeless: understanding and helping people. User experience (UX) and human-centered design combine creativity, structure, and empathy to solve real problems — and create better experiences for real people.   In a world increasingly driven by AI, human-centered design and UX are more valuable than ever. AI can automate tasks — but it can’t empathize, imagine, or understand people’s needs and goals. That’s where UX and human-centered design come in: they are where technology meets humanity. When you master these skills, you don’t just adapt to the future — you help define it.   Get industry-trusted course certificates to boost your credibility.   Since 2002, we’ve had over 1.2 million enrollments and helped people fast-track their careers and make a meaningful difference, while supporting millions more through open-source content. We collaborate with over 250 leading designers from Google, NASA, Harvard, and Adobe to make world-class learning accessible.   Get started:   Turn your passion into a paycheck — and build a career you love: https://ixdf.org/why-learn-design-with-ixdf   Break into design or fast-track your career with 40+ expert-led courses: https://ixdf.org/courses   Accelerate your career with 180+ expert-led, 1-hour Master Classes: https://ixdf.org/master-classes   Explore more:   How IxDF helps you start and grow your design career:  https://ixdf.org/about   Join a free local IxDF Meetup in your city — make friends, grow your skills, and find new job opportunities:  https://ixdf.org/community

Vocator’s technology goes beyond keywords, matching candidates and employers based on hard skills, personality, and professional fit. For companies, that means faster hiring and higher-quality matches. For candidates, it means fair opportunities and a clear path to roles that truly align with their strengths.  We believe the future of hiring is human, enhanced by AI. Vocator is built to help teams make better decisions, build stronger connections, and fill roles faster.

name: Institute of Chartered Shipbrokers
tagline: The royal charter professional body for all members of the commercial shipping industry worldwide.
description: The Institute of Chartered Shipbrokers (ICS) is open to anyone who wishes to start or already has a career in shipping or the maritime industry. You can begin your journey to becoming a member by studying interesting shipping and maritime subjects and sitting our professional exams when you are ready.   The Institute is the professional body for all members of the commercial shipping industry worldwide. Founded in 1911, the Institute was awarded a Royal Charter in 1920. We set and examine the syllabus for membership, providing the shipping industry with highly qualified professionals, and we are the only internationally recognised professional body in the commercial maritime arena representing shipbrokers, ship managers and agents throughout the world.  We have 26 branches in key locations worldwide with 4,000 individual Members and Fellows. Members of the Institute are committed to maintaining the highest professional standards across the shipping industry and, as part of a professional body, members enjoy the benefits of an enhanced career in the shipping industry.   Do you want to become a member? There has never been a more important time to invest in your career.  Contact us to discover the Institute's education programmes that are available worldwide both face to face and online. To talk through your options, please feel free to book a consultation with one of our education advisors: education@ics.org.uk

name: BRAC Ultra-Poor Graduation Initiative
tagline: Scaling the Graduation approach through governments to empower 4.6 million households to escape extreme poverty by 2026.
description: BRAC, the world’s largest NGO, wanted to help previously unreachable people in extreme poverty build sustainable livelihoods long-term. So, in 2002 we pioneered the Graduation approach - a holistic sequence of interventions that empowers people to escape the poverty trap for good. When LSE researchers found 95 percent of participants in Bangladesh continued improving their living standards seven years after the intervention ended, we knew Graduation had the potential to transform lives.  Building on that success, BRAC Ultra-Poor Graduation Initiative aims to scale Graduation through governments worldwide to enable 4.6 million more households to escape extreme poverty by 2026, integrating with existing programs and supporting policy change to better meet the needs of people experiencing the most severe poverty.

name: MenEngage Alliance
tagline: Dismantle unequal power relations & patriarchal systems by transforming masculinities & working with men/boy in feminism
description: MenEngage Alliance is a space for organizations and individuals to come together in solidarity with those most targeted by gender injustice and patriarchal systems to collectively dismantle structural barriers to gender equality, climate and social justice. As a global network, we bring together people and organizations with a shared vision of a world in which gender justice and human rights are recognized, promoted and protected, where all people are equal and free from discrimination and oppression.  Our work with men and boys stems from the pioneering work and ongoing leadership of women’s rights and LGBTQI movements. This means we root our understanding of the world in feminist theory and an understanding that patriarchy is a system at the centre of women’s and LGBTQI person’s human rights violations and gender inequalities.  The mission of MenEngage Alliance is to transform unequal power relations and dismantle patriarchal systems by: - Transforming patriarchal masculinities and rigid, harmful norms around ‘being a man’ - Working with men and boys on gender justice through intersectional feminist approaches - Building inclusive collaborations from local to regional to global levels - Developing joint actions in partnership with and accountability to women’s rights, gender- and other social justice movements.

name: Association for Women's Rights in Development (AWID)
tagline: We support feminist and gender justice movements to thrive, challenge oppressions and co-create feminist realities
description: The Association for Women's Rights in Development (AWID) is a global, feminist, membership, movement-support organization.   For over 35 years, AWID has been a part of an incredible ecosystem of feminist movements working to achieve gender justice and women’s human rights worldwide.  Our Initiatives work at the intersections of the sites of change we work to address, the movements we prioritize, and the tactics we use​:  Advancing Universal Rights and Justice: We monitor, document and make visible how anti-rights actors are operating and colluding in multilateral spaces and support feminist, women’s rights and gender justice movements and allies to counter their influence and impact.  Building Feminist Economies: Working on extractivism, tax justice and corporate accountability, we build knowledge on corporate power and influence; advocate for corporate accountability and equitable distribution of wealth; and amplify feminist proposals for just economies.   Resourcing Feminist Movements: We develop accessible, action-oriented analysis on the state of resourcing for feminist movements. We aim to influence funders’ policies and practices, deepen and sustain funding for feminist social change, and support movements’ needs and strategies.    Co-Creating Feminist Realities: We unearth, co-create and amplify feminist realities, proposals and narratives and in doing so, contribute to making visible feminism in practice, inspiring exchange and joint action, and providing spaces for strategizing, thus increasing the collective impact and power of feminist alternatives.

name: IAWL ~ Institute for African Women in Law
tagline: A network of women legal professionals dedicated to using the law for social change and development.
description: The Institute for African Women in Law is a non-profit organization registered under US law. It is made up of a network of women legal professionals across Africa and the Diaspora dedicated to using the law as a tool for societal change and development. Our focal programmatic areas include Research, Advocacy, Technical Engagement, and Mentoring. We seek to improve and increase spaces within the legal professions for African women. Our innovative approach uses a cross-sectional approach by removing the silos of professional organizations and blending professional boundaries.   Our network includes judges, lawyers, legal academics, and lawyers working in non-legal organizations such as in international diplomacy. Our collective actions are oriented towards having an intergenerational impact through intra-generational peer-mentoring and inter-generational cross-mentoring of young women and girls aspiring to become lawyers and the next generation of women champions for the continent of Africa.  Our membership is open to women across Africa and the Black Diaspora. We welcome and highly encourage the participation of men who are committed to women's success.  In pursuit of our vision, we have launched the campaign #AfricanGenderSolidarity to achieve our communal goals and aspirations as human beings. Join us and let us make a difference!

tagline: Your Wealth
description: The South African Institute of Professional Accountants (SAIPA) is a leading accountancy institute representing suitably qualified Professional Accountants (SA), in practice, commerce and industry, academia and the public sector. SAIPA leads the way in forging a new and dynamic role for the Professional Accountant (SA) to fulfil the escalating demands made by business in South Africa’s growing economy by equipping members with the latest knowledge, techniques and accreditation in the increasingly advanced services they render.  INTERNATIONAL AFFILIATIONS SAIPA is a full member of the International Federation of Accountants (IFAC) and the Pan African Federation of Accountants (PAFA). SAIPA has beneficial reciprocal agreements with national and international bodies including; the Certified Public Accountants (CPA) in Ireland, the Institute of Public Accountants (IPA) in Australia, the Institute of Commercial and Financial Accountants (CFA) in Namibia, the Sumara Institute of Professional Accountants (SIPA) in Russia and the Institute of Financial Accountants (IFA) in the United Kingdom.

name: CIVICUS: World Alliance for Citizen Participation
description:
CIVICUS is an international alliance of members and partners which constitute an influential network of organisations at the local, national, regional and international levels, and span the spectrum of civil society including: civil society networks and organisations; trade unions; faith-based networks; professional associations; NGO capacity development organisations; philanthropic foundations and other funding bodies; businesses; and social responsibility programmes.
 
 Mission:
 CIVICUS is an international alliance dedicated to strengthening citizen action and civil society throughout the world.
 
 Vision:
 A worldwide community of informed, inspired, committed citizens engaged in confronting the challenges facing humanity.
 
 CIVICUS seeks to amplify the voices and opinions of ordinary people. It recognises that for effective and sustainable civic participation to occur, citizens must enjoy rights of free association and be able to engage all sectors of society.
 
 Join the CIVICUS Alliance  at  www.civicus.org/join

name: Afrobarometer
tagline: Let the people have a say.
description: Afrobarometer is a pan-African, non-partisan research network that conducts public attitude surveys on democracy, governance, economic conditions, and related issues in more than 35 countries in Africa. It is a network of researchers who do scientific citizen-attitude surveys aimed at ensuring that people's views inform the decisions of policy-makers, academics, activists and others. name: GARC - Rabies Alliance
tagline: Ending rabies. Empowering communities.
description: We are the world's leading non-profit organization working to end human and animal deaths from rabies. Every year an estimated 59,000 people and countless dogs die of, or because of, this preventable disease.   We work with major global partners (WHO, FAO, WOAH) and governments to bring an end to this needless loss of life.  We provide technical assistance to governments in endemic areas to help them make the most of their budgets and move towards sustainable rabies elimination. Our projects have protected over 5 million people from the threat of the disease and vaccinated over 400,000 dogs.   We support regional elimination efforts through our regional rabies control networks (e.g., Pan African Rabies Control Network –PARACON) and promote global coordination through our Partners for Rabies Prevention group.    We initiated, with the US CDC, and coordinate World Rabies Day, September 28. A day of action and awareness raising - particularly in at-risk communities.  And as part of our mission, we are galvanising international support to raise the profile of the disease through the End Rabies Now campaign: endrabiesnow.org  #EndRabiesNow.

name: Climate Finance Accelerator (CFA)
tagline: Capacity building programme which helps unlock climate finance for low-carbon projects in emerging economies.
description: The Climate Finance Accelerator (CFA) is a four-year technical assistance programme, funded by the UK Government's International Climate Finance in the Department for Energy Security and Net Zero (DESNZ).   It responds directly to the urgency and scale of the climate crisis by supporting highly promising low-carbon projects to become more bankable and appealing to investors.   The CFA addresses the challenges involved in attracting climate finance to where it is most needed by bringing together stakeholders that can develop and finance climate projects at scale. By doing this it helps countries to meet their Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) pledges under the Paris Agreement.  CFA projects receive capacity building support in areas such as low-carbon technology, blending finance from public and private sources, as well as advice on enhancing gender, equality and social inclusion.   The programme currently operates in Colombia, Egypt, Mexico, Nigeria, Pakistan, Peru, South Africa, Turkiye, Uganda and Viet Nam. Local delivery partners manage the programme and shape the CFA so that it’s tailored to each country, supported by a UK-based core delivery team. It is intended that a sustainable CFA process will be established in each participating country to generate a ongoing pipeline of low-carbon projects.  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- This page is an output from a project funded by the UK government. name: DataTech Recruitment
tagline: Building stronger teams through specialist recruitment, honest advice, and long-term partnerships.
description: At DataTech Recruitment, we help South African companies hire people who fit your team, your pace and your plans - not just your job description.  Tech hiring can feel noisy. Too many CVs. Too little clarity. Too many near-misses. We cut through that with a process that’s calm, personal and built on proper conversations. Every candidate is screened by us. Every client gets clear feedback and honest guidance, start to finish.  We specialise in Software Development, Data, Cloud, Cybersecurity and IT Leadership. Most of our work is with start-ups and SMEs who want a partner they can actually talk to, not another agency pushing volume.  You can work with us in two ways: *Contingency when you need flexibility and want to explore the market without upfront commitment. You pay only when you hire. *Retained when the role is too important to gamble on. You get dedicated time, market mapping, structured shortlists and steady communication — the kind that keeps everyone aligned.  Both routes give you access to our network, our screening, our market insight and our honest view of what’s possible. The difference is how closely you want us in the room with you.  Although tech is our home, clients often ask us to support roles across their wider teams - from Engineers and Technicians to Scientists, Admin and Procurement. When it aligns with our process, we help.  Based in South Africa. Working nationwide. Supporting select international clients who value long-term partnership over quick wins.  Clear. Human. Recruitment that feels better.

name: Green Building Council South Africa (GBCSA)
tagline: Transforming the built environment for people and planet to thrive.
description:
The Green Building Council of South Africa (GBCSA) is an independent, non-profit organisation, established in September 2007 to promote green building in South Africa’s commercial property industry.  A green building is a building which is energy efficient, resource efficient and environmentally responsible- which incorporates design, construction and operational practices that significantly reduce or eliminate its negative impact on the environment and its occupants. Building green is an opportunity to use resources efficiently and address climate change while creating healthier and more productive environments for people to live and work in.
 
 The GBCSA is a full member of the World GBC (www.worldgbc.org).
 
 GBCSA Vision:
 
 To lead the transformation of the South African property industry to ensure that all buildings are designed, built and operated in an environmentally sustainable way to allow South Africans to work and live in healthy, efficient and productive environments. 
 
 GBCSA Mission:
 
 To promote, encourage and facilitate green building in the South African property and construction industry through market-based solutions.
 
 The main functions of the GBCSA are to:
 
 1.	Promote and raise awareness of green building, 
 2.	Establish a  green building rating system for South Africa,
 3.	Provide green building education, and
 4.	Make knowledge and resources available to assist those that want to implement green building.

name: African Tax Administration Forum (ATAF)
tagline: Building effective and efficient tax systems in Africa.
description: The African Tax Administration Forum (ATAF) is a platform to promote and facilitate mutual cooperation among African Tax Administrations (and other relevant and interested stakeholders) with the aim of improving the efficacy of their tax legislation and administrations. The Forum brings together Heads of African Tax Administrations and their representatives to discuss the progress made, challenges faced and possible new direction for African tax policy and administration in the 21st Century.  The ATAF was inspired by the deliberations at the “International Conference on Taxation, State Building and Capacity Development in Africa” held in Pretoria, South Africa from 28 - 29 August 2008.  Commissioners, Senior Tax Administrators and Policy Makers from 28 African countries resolved to work towards the establishment of the ATAF.  ATAF remains firmly committed to our primary mandate of building effective and efficient tax administrations on the continent, recognising that this is a critical element in boosting revenue mobilisation and building a capable state that is able to meet the needs of its citizens.

description: Canada Abroad is a Canadian Immigration consulting company based in Ottawa, Ontario. Our Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant has over 12 years of experience in the Canadian immigration industry, including 5 years as a Canada Border Services Offices, with a focus on immigration. She has also gone through the immigration process herself (to South Africa) and is able to relate to our clients on a personal level.  We assist clients from around the world with achieving their goal of immigrating to Canada. For most of our clients, they immigrate to Canada using one of the immigration programs which uses the Express Entry system.   On January 1st, 2015, Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (formerly known as Citizenship and Immigration Canada) introduced the Express Entry System. Many people refer to this as the "Canada Express Entry Visa" or "Canada Express Visa."  Express Entry is a file management system used by Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada for certain immigration applications and is not an actual immigration program itself. The Canada Express Entry system is now used by anyone seeking to immigrate to Canada as a Federal Skilled Worker, Federal Skilled Tradesperson, member of the Canadian Experience Class or a Provincial Nominee. Once you have applied through the Express Entry system, you are then assigned a Comprehensive Ranking System (CRS) score which will determine if you will be chosen to immigrate to Canada. It is possible for those who meet the criteria of one of the eligible immigration programs to not get to successfully immigrate to Canada if their Comprehensive Ranking System (CRS) score is too low.  Visit our website to read the requirements of the Express Entry system and the eligible immigration programs. www.canadaabroad.com

IBIA currently has offices in the UK and Singapore.

name: Moshal Program - South Africa
description: The Moshal Program (MP) was established in 2010 by Martin Moshal and its vision is to make a difference in the lives of students, their families, their communities and hopefully the wider world one day. The MP currently provides scholarships to over 700 Scholars in South Africa, Israel and the Ukraine to enable determined young people from challenging backgrounds to attend the top universities in their home countries.   We offer scholarships to students in a select range of subjects, including engineering, IT and computer science, medicine and health sciences, economics, and business. The MSP provides funding for tuition, accommodation, text books, food and a small living allowance to enable the students, to focus full time on their studies without financial stress. The MP offers personal support, as well as exposure to a variety of workshops for skills development, preparing the students for the job market and independent lives.    Moshal Scholars are selected because they have demonstrated the tenacity, ambition, resilience and commitment to succeed, despite the considerable challenges that they may have faced. We also select students who we believe embody the spirit and values of the Program.  These include hard work, perseverance, tolerance, integrity, humility, accountability, caring, respect, community and the '​'Pay It Forward'​'​ principle of contributing to our Program and wider society one day.   We do not expect our students to pay us back but we inculcate a philosophy of ‘’paying it forward’’ and we expect those students who can, to help others in future.   Our Selection Process is based on partnerships. We do not accept unsolicited applications from students. We partner with various organisations (NGOs, schools, municipalities etc.) in each country who work with high school students from challenging backgrounds, as well as with some financial aid offices at the universities concerned.

The Foundation was founded on the philosophy of ‘ubuntu’, the African concept of giving and caring for your neighbour and other members of your community. This selfless and compassionate quality is part of the age-old African culture and expresses the core value of humanity as goodness to our fellow men. The act of giving back has been and still is an integral part of our moral duty and collective responsibility. It is a concept that has held African families and communities together for generations, despite the continent’s many challenges. We are proud to pass it on to the next generation.

name: African Infrastructure Investment Managers (AIIM)
tagline: Africa's trusted infrastructure investor
description: ACTIVELY INVESTING IN AFRICA’S GROWTH FOR 25 YEARS  AIIM understands the African business environment and has experience spanning a range of infrastructure asset classes. We develop, create, advise and manage private equity infrastructure funds.   AIIM has funds under management of USD3.4 billion and a track record extending across eight infrastructure funds. The funds managed and advised by AIIM are designed to invest long-term institutional unlisted equity in African infrastructure projects such as toll roads, renewable energy, power generation, port and communication infrastructure assets.   With one of the most experienced infrastructure transaction and management teams in Africa, AIIM provides strategic, commercial, operational and financial expertise into infrastructure investment activities throughout Sub-Saharan Africa.   The depth of knowledge and experience within AIIM allows for the identification of quality investment opportunities as well as a disciplined approach to the investment and asset management process.  AIIM has positioned itself as a leading infrastructure equity investment manager in the African landscape providing compelling investment opportunities that seek to deliver superior returns for investors, adding value through effective environmental, social and governance management, while making a tangible contribution to local economies and communities.  AIIM was established in 2000 as a joint venture between the Macquarie Group and Old Mutual Investment Group. With a vision to become one of Africa’s premier alternative asset managers, Old Mutual Alternative Investments acquired Macquarie’s 50% shareholding in November 2015, making it the sole shareholder of AIIM.

name: White Desert
tagline: Pioneers in deep-field luxury Antarctic travel.
description: With three camps in the interior of the continent, White Desert has been pioneering luxury Antarctic travel for over 20 years.  Most people who reach Antarctica see it from the deck of a cruise ship. Fewer than 800 a year ever reach the interior. That's the world we operate in. After a five-and-a-half-hour flight from Cape Town, our private plane lands on an airstrip of blue glacial ice, where we run three luxury camps built where almost no one has stood.  Getting people there safely and comfortably, every season, is one of the hardest logistics problems in travel. Our fuel and vehicles are shipped months ahead and driven hundreds of kilometres across crevasse fields. Our chefs cook a full season of meals in Cape Town before anyone arrives. We operate Wolf's Fang, the only private-jet runway in Antarctica. And our guides and pilots are among the best professionals in their field on the planet — which is why we've kept a near-perfect safety record across two decades.  The same capability that carries our guests also supports science. Each year, we fly over 250 scientists to research bases across the interior. We've been carbon neutral since 2007 and were the first to trial Sustainable Aviation Fuel on the continent. Every camp is built to be fully removed, leaving only a minor, transitory trace. The White Desert Foundation extends our environmental responsibility through three areas: supporting science, investing in blue carbon, and education.  Founded by polar explorer Patrick Woodhead, White Desert employs over 150 people from 18 nationalities, working from Cape Town and on the ice through the Antarctic season. In 2025 we moved beyond the polar world for the first time with Dr Jones — journeys to some of Earth's least-explored places aboard a fully restored 1940s DC-3.  If you would like to learn more, please get in touch.

name: Fortress Real Estate Investments Limited
tagline: Powering Growth Through Logistics and Retail Real Estate
description: Fortress Real Estate is one of South Africa’s largest real estate companies, with a growing footprint across Central and Eastern Europe (CEE). We connect businesses with growth-focused opportunities through state-of-the-art logistics parks and commuter-oriented retail centres.  We own a portfolio of logistics properties in South Africa and Central and Eastern Europe valued at R21,1 billion and a portfolio of retail properties of R11,8 billion, all located in South Africa.  The Fortress Logistics portfolio now constitutes two-thirds of Fortress’s total assets, including a logistics portfolio in Poland and Romania. As the country’s largest owner and developer of premium-grade logistics real estate, we deliver innovative and secure solutions that help clients scale and adapt, whether through bespoke partnerships or speculative builds.   Our retail portfolio strategy is focused on commuter-oriented and convenience retail shopping centres, located in townships, rural areas, suburban nodes and CBDs. These locations cater to shoppers who prioritise proximity, value and reliability. What sets Fortress apart is our understanding that retail is not only about space, but also about community infrastructure and support.   Our commitment to sustainability is evident in our properties, which have been designed to meet high environmental standards and equipped with features like solar PV panels and intelligent energy monitoring systems.   Through our 15.2% interest in NEPI Rockcastle, valued at nearly R16 billion, we also provide investors with exposure to the high-growth retail sector in CEE markets.   Collaboration is core to our culture. At Fortress, we create value not only for our tenants and partners, but also for our people, communities and the environment, powering growth.

tagline: Empowering youth voices, driving innovation, and building inclusive, sustainable communities across Africa.
description: The Youth Café is a not-for-profit pan-African youth organization founded in Kenya in 2012 and officially registered in 2014. Since our founding, our strategy has always been to look at today's youth bulge as an opportunity for development and economic growth. This is why are the seen as the lead organisation for implementing multidisciplinary and multi-perspective projects including Peace and Security, Preventing Violent Extremism; Governance and Political Inclusion (Remittances and Accountability); Culture, Arts, and Sports; Education and Skills; Business, Job Creation and Entrepreneurship, Universal Health Coverage, Environmental Preservation and Climate Change.   We aim to model, inform, and advance youth-led approaches to sustainable development, environmental stewardship, social equity, democratic governance, and economic viability by utilizing innovative research, media, policy, advocacy, as well as cross-cultural and intergenerational partnerships. To date, we have reached 1.6 million young people across Africa.  Context and bases for the establishment for The Youth Cafe: Young people make up the bulk of Africa’s total population with an estimated 75% of the continent’s population below the age of 35. From a demographic point of view, this calls for a paradigm shift towards the recognition and support of the youth to harness their potential to foster community resilience, propose innovative solutions, drive social progress, youth empowerment and inspire political change. Young people are a tremendous and essential asset worth investing in. We hope to open the door to an unparalleled multiplier effect as our message spreads. Contact us at info@theyouthcafe.com.

name: Strategic African Women In Leadership (SAWIL)
tagline:
Transformation through: 

Board Training & Placemen| Executive Coaching| Leadership Development|Networking|Collaboration
description: ​An organization for women who believe in the idea of “Lifting as you rise”.  SAWIL was established in 2014 by Seipati Mokhuoa as a proudly South African Women In Leadership organisation serving women leaders in corporate South Africa. We later took a bold and vital decision in 2019 to expand to the SADC region as Southern African Women In Leadership. The rapid growth we enjoyed in the SADC region informed our decision to extend our offering to the rest of Africa in 2021 as proudly Strategic African Women In Leadership. The common thread that holds us together and essentially informs our mission and vision is to see more African Women take their rightful place as leaders and economic powerhouses in our continent.   SAWIL is a vehicle for women leaders, entrepreneurs and professionals in Africa seeking to advance their careers through leadership training, executive coaching, entrepreneurship training, masterclasses, board training, mentorship and networking. With the sole objective of transforming and diversifying leadership composition, particularly in the private sector, our ultimate goal is to bring a more strategic approach towards women's development and empowerment.   We have over the years honed practical and tested strategies that enable companies to engage, reconsider, take on a different leadership transformation approach, and prioritise gender equality, diversity and inclusion in the workplace.   We at SAWIL firmly attribute and draw our inspiration from (amongst other factors) the women of 1956 in South Africa who marched together to the Union Buildings from all walks of life, not defined by race/religion/culture but one common agenda: Transformation and Inclusion.    Together with our members, stakeholders, and partners, our collective vision is to accelerate inspired, head and heart leadership pioneers.   Visit our website to join the movement.
